svg.aria-label: Upper panel: the Lane-Emden function theta against the dimensionless radius xi for polytropic indices 0, 1, one and a half, 3, 4 and 5. The first zero moves outward as the index rises and runs to infinity at index 5. Lower panel: density divided by central density against fractional radius, on a logarithmic scale, for the index three-halves and index three polytropes and for the tabulated standard solar model. The solar profile falls faster than either polytrope.
svg.text: Solutions of the Lane–Emden equation θ″ + (2/ξ)θ′ + θⁿ = 0
filled dot: the surface ξ₁, the first zero of θ
n = 5 has none: finite mass, infinite radius
The same solutions as density profiles, against the Sun
ρc/ρ̄ : 106.9 tabulated, 54.2 for n = 3, 6.0 for n = 3/2
the Sun is more centrally condensed than either polytrope, by a factor 1.97 on n = 3
Solar profile: BS2005-AGS,OP, Bahcall, Serenelli & Basu (2005), ApJ 621, L85.
Polytropes integrated numerically and checked against the exact n = 0, 1 and 5 solutions.
